implementation_status_note: B0, W0-W1, W2 and W3 are complete. W4 has begun: the TraCI call surface is IMPLEMENTED and EXERCISED against a live SUMO process. Three bounded interface arms were run on a TRAINING map; no episode was run to completion, no capture was attempted, no success was scored, and no optimizer run, checkpoint load or TEST access has occurred in this root.

B0.verdict_note: B0 is a provenance and governance task. It produces no scientific claim.

W0.verdict_note: Novelty NOT established; POTENTIAL_DIFFERENCE unchanged. B06 now read at FULL_TEXT (14 pages); the r03 entry was taken from a truncated 6-page render and OMITTED B06's k-agent adjacency capture predicate, which is corrected AGAINST this project in A-33. The C05 difference is re-grounded on when a cardinality certificate stops being sound, not on the absence of a joint condition. Backward citation chasing on B06's 22 references added two constraining ancestors: Jennings 1993 (commitments and conventions) NARROWS H2 a second time - commitment under a revision rule is 1993 prior art and switch_margin is a convention in that sense; Riedmiller and Withopf 2005 (multi-option framework, centralized meta-agent choosing a joint option) is the closest structural relative of C04 and is NOT OBTAINABLE - publisher CLOSED, abstract elided, no open copy. T-CARE also remains unread: no SAGE subscription. C03/C04 distinctness stays BLOCKED.

W1.verdict_note: Analytical correctness SUPPORTED: 14/14 frozen finite cases PASS against expectations derived by hand before implementation; 58 unit tests pass; four cross-check properties hold. This is the weakest of the eight claim classes and implies none of the other seven.

W2.verdict_note: Engineering acceptance SUPPORTED: preflight consistent, 145/145 tests across 10 modules, W0-W1 regression 14/14 against unchanged frozen expectations, lint clean. Engineering acceptance permits only the next gated scientific test; it is not a scientific result. Capture parameters are PROPOSED, not frozen.

W3.verdict_note: Engineering acceptance SUPPORTED: 9/9 frozen checks, 188 tests on both the pinned and a bare interpreter, lint clean. State restoration is exact and a verified prefix couples a replay; a shared seed alone does not. EXPLICITLY NOT VALIDATED: the TraCI call surface, because no SUMO process was started. COMPLETED 2026-09-21: simulator/evader.py delivered after D08 was frozen, closing deviation D-14. Difficulty ordering verified MONOTONE (dead-end rates 0.470 / 0.275 / 0.000); an inverted ordering was caught by measurement and fixed. The D06 dead-end rule is now checkable because every evader decision logs its admissible alternatives.

W4_PREREQUISITE_ARRIVAL_MODEL.verdict_note: DIRECTION_UNRESOLVED and UNDER REFUTED. The recorded errors are unsigned magnitudes so the approximation direction cannot be established from the historical record; independently, certified bounds are absent on all 5980 rows, refuting UNDER. Under Rule A, NO joint opportunity can ever be SUPPORTED from an arrival model of this kind. Only a constructive schedule yields UNDER.

W4_PREREQUISITE_CONSTRUCTIVE_WITNESSES.verdict_note: UNDER arrival sets CAN be produced and the label EARNED, in the declared finite abstraction only. All six frozen criteria pass. Every reported time carries a SpeedProfile verified by integration: worst distance error 4.26e-14 m and worst time error 0.0 s over 400 samples, 0 legality violations. First SUPPORTED opportunity verdict in the project backed by generated rather than hand-written sets. NOT established: production on a real network, or interaction between participants' committed plans.

claim_status.state_restoration: REFUTED_AGAINST_SUMO_SUPPORTED_AGAINST_A_FIXTURE. SUMO 1.21.0 writes vehicle pos and speed at a fixed two decimals and --precision does not govern those fields, so loadState restores a state quantised to 1 cm and 1 cm/s and the continuation diverges BY CONSTRUCTION. See A-37.
claim_status.arrival_model_direction: UNDER REFUTED FOR PREDICTIVE MODELS (0/5598). UNDER ACHIEVABLE CONSTRUCTIVELY IN THE FINITE ABSTRACTION. UNDER REFUTED ON REAL NETWORKS for constructive schedules, replicated across 4 maps and 12 routes (A-41). The earliest time in any UNDER set has zero slack by construction and is unreachable in practice.
claim_status.assistance_audit_replay_coupling: RECOVERED VIA RE-EXECUTION. saveState/loadState cannot carry it (A-37), but two fresh starts with the same seed are exactly identical and a shared prefix stays exactly coupled when the arms diverge later (A-38). Verified with 3 vehicles on one TRAINING map over 30 decisions, with no vehicle entering or leaving the network.
claim_status.interaction_half_of_the_constructive_pro: IMPLEMENTED_AND_CONTROLLED_IN_THE_FINITE_ABSTRACTION. The circularity is stated as an operator and searched constructively; witnesses are verified on three conditions. NO EXISTENCE THEOREM: Kakutani needs convex values and these sets are deliberately nonconvex, so a failed search reports NOT_FOUND_ON_THIS_GRID and never non-existence. See A-39.
claim_status.constructive_transfer_to_the_network: REFUTED, REPLICATED, AND ITS MAGNITUDE CORRECTED DOWNWARD. Under a speed limit that includes internal junction lanes, median error is 4.35 s not 39.6 s and 2 of 12 routes keep feasibility throughout. Still 0 of 12 arrive within the 0.1 s tolerance, so the refutation stands. See A-42.
claim_status.approach_model_on_the_network: SIGNAL-AWARE MODEL BUILT AND VALIDATED. Confirms traffic lights as the residual mechanism: predicts a 121 s signal wait to within 0.115 s. Worst deviation 117.0 s -> 5.6 s. DOES NOT YET EARN UNDER: optimistic on 8 of 12 routes. Blocked on a distance discrepancy of up to 42.3 m whose cause is not identified. See A-43.
claim_status.capture_predicate_satisfiability: SATISFIABLE IN SUMO (A-46): an evader brought to rest behind a pursuer satisfies the frozen physical predicate with safety checks on and no collision; a trailing pursuer cannot. Coordination not yet tested.

resolved_decisions.D12: RESOLVED 2026-09-24 by the Research lead. HELPER: the non-finisher pursuer with the smallest body separation to the evader at the start of the factual capture witness; ties to the lexicographically smallest id; no eligible helper -> assistance UNRESOLVED. TIME: the decision boundary 5 decisions before the witness start; if fewer than 5 precede it, start at decision 0 and record the truncation. b1: each decision, route by shortest path toward the evader's current public position, same limits and interface; then return to the frozen policy. Uses only the factual trace, never a counterfactual outcome.

resolved_decisions.D12_REVISION_2026_09_25: RESOLVED by the Research lead, before any r02 case. Helper selection and b1 UNCHANGED. INTERVENTION TIME revised: the helper's SETTLING time is the earliest decision from which, until the witness start, it stays within 1.0 m of its position at the witness start; b1 runs the 5 decisions ending at that settling time, then the helper returns to its policy. A helper moving until the capture has settling time = witness start, so the rule reduces exactly to the original D12. Trajectory-based, factual trace only, applies to every arm. Truncation at decision 0 recorded. Reason: A-50 - the original window cannot see positional coordination, and D12 governs the assistance audit through W5-W7.
